name: Stability Ball Chest Stretch
steps: Kneel facing a stability ball and place both forearms across the top with your elbows wide.
Move your knees back slightly and hinge at your hips while the ball rolls forward.
Lower your chest between your arms until you feel a gentle stretch across the front of both shoulders.
Hold while breathing evenly, then press your forearms down and bring your torso upright.
tips: Keep your lower ribs drawn in so your back stays comfortable as your chest lowers.
Let the shoulders open gradually without forcing your chest toward the floor.
